clips.title: The story
paras: In Anvilmar, the Frostmane novices' Feather Charms draw a warlock instructor's interest. Their crude trinkets carry a faint magical power.

Southwest of Anvilmar, Frostmane novices carry feather charms through the snowy caverns. Their tribe is known for territorial savagery, yet the young trolls dabble in primitive spellcraft. The charms hold a faint but unmistakable magical power. In Anvilmar, warlock instructor Alamar Grimm studies this crude trollcraft with interest. He uses the charms as a proving ground for fledgling warlocks seeking to master the binding of their first imp.
